notes.title: Patch Notes #6 | V0.6.56
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/3074cd07e863acaf553b81e00ef695796d6d2e71.png[/img][h3][b]With this update, you can fully automate your sales. Stay tuned for bigger updates ! [/b][/h3]

also;

notes.title: Patch Notes #4 | V0.4.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/5f0b5be1f712e5a5a0479d482aabf26fd3fd4668.png[/img]
Hello gamers!!
First Milestone has been reached. thank you all for supporting us so far, we will reach furder milestones fast as we can ! 

[h2]Updates🚀[/h2]
[list]
[*]🚀The feature to name your shop has been added! (You can change it in computer)
[*]🚀Icons indicating the remaining quantity and game category have been added to make game boxes more prominent.
[*]🚀Toggle buttons for on-screen indicators in the bottom left were implemented to reduce clutter during certain operations.
[*]🚀Spanish language updated.
[*]🚀Portuguese language updated.
[*]🚀Ads are now effective from the day of purchase.
[*]🚀Fuel ratios of vehicles have been slightly readjusted
[*]🚀An animation has been added to the UI at the bottom center of the screen when a player is carrying a box.
[*]🚀Vehicle damage rates have been increased.
[/list]

[h2] Fixes 🛠️[/h2]
[list]
[*]🛠️An issue causing negative values for the boxes of games sold in the online sales section has been fixed.
[*]🛠️An issue causing unlimited money in Blackjack has been fixed.
[*]🛠️An issue causing speed indicators not to appear in third-person camera view for some vehicles has been fixed.
[*]🛠️An issue causing boxes to disappear when selling a vehicle with boxes on it has been fixed.
[/list]

Special thanks to our community member [b]ItzDesativado_ [/b]and [b]Blxxded[/b] for helping us!

notes.title: Game Store Simulator Roadmap Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Excitingly announcing! Big updates are on the way for our game![/b][/h2]

[h2]Milestone 1[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/d1eed0966c069c263bb6b4b7bb8a0d52cbfe0e17.png[/img]
[h3][list]
[*] A feature to name your shop will be added.
[*] The content inside game boxes will be made more understandable.
[*] Spanish language support will be updated.
[/list][/h3]


[h2]Milestone 2[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/57ebcb7745ca1992aec2933fafc5bce3adca6cf9.png[/img]
[h3][list]
[*] Roulette game will be added, ramp up the excitement!
[*] A mini-game is coming to the computer! (Points earned will convert into real money.)
[*] NPC appearances will be changed.
[/list][/h3]


[h2]Milestone 3[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/7a15a94acbf3a2f43ec55a614c4c14959ce55009.png[/img]
[h3][list]
[*] Cleaning robots and security personnel are joining the game.
[*] The UI for organizing shelves will be completely redesigned.
[/list][/h3]


[h2]Milestone 4[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623567/4fc1fbed3dc0b1a7f767f40904d5245839211a81.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3]Steam Achievements will be added to our game.
[*] Unlock the upgrade for the 3rd shop, where new decorations and vehicles await you.
[*] A few new music tracks will be added to the game.
[*] A player model will be integrated into vehicles.[/h3]
[/list]


And this is just the beginning! With each update, your gaming experience will further develop with numerous improvements in UI/UX, translation, and the economy. We're eagerly waiting for you, don't miss the updates! 🚀🎮

[b]-Pex Entertainment Team[/b]
